verses.html: Elihu also proceeded, and said,
verses.text: Elihu also proceeded, and said,

verses.html: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God's behalf.
verses.text: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God's behalf.

verses.html: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.text: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

verses.html: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.
verses.text: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

verses.html: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.
verses.text: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.

verses.html: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.
verses.text: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.

verses.html: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.
verses.text: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.

verses.html: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;
verses.text: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;

verses.html: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.
verses.text: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.

verses.html: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.
verses.text: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.

verses.html: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
verses.text: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

verses.html: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.
verses.text: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

verses.html: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.
verses.text: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.

verses.html: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.
verses.text: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.

verses.html: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.
verses.text: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.

verses.html: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.
verses.text: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.

verses.html: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.
verses.text: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.

verses.html: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.
verses.text: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.

verses.html: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.
verses.text: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.

verses.html: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.
verses.text: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

verses.html: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
verses.text: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

verses.html: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?
verses.text: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?

verses.html: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?
verses.text: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?

verses.html: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.
verses.text: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.

verses.html: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.
verses.text: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.

verses.html: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.
verses.text: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.

verses.html: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:
verses.text: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

verses.html: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.
verses.text: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.

verses.html: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?
verses.text: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?

verses.html: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.
verses.text: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.

verses.html: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.
verses.text: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.

verses.html: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.
verses.text: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.

verses.html: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
verses.text: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
